liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Jerry and Bobby's slide work in the first set is highlighted, especially in Stagger Lee [9]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The He's Gone performance is identified as the standout moment of the second set [5]

## The recordings

- **gd78-12-16.wagner.wiley.9482.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 187 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1978-12-16.sonyecm250-dolbyb.walker-scotton.miller.82211.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1978-12-16.sonyecm250-no-dolby.walker-scotton.miller.82212.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.28/5 by 96 [3]. Said about its sound: Microphones are positioned centrally, offering great levels and high-end clarity despite distance; The show features a jerky rhythm and Donna in good form, though not innovative [8][13]
- **gd1978-12-16.aud.stephens.8841.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 167 min [4]

## Around the show

- The crowd was described as mellow for a Saturday night performance [5]
- A friend attended his first show, snoring comfortably with feet up on the rail [6]
- The venue was not full, with reams of unsold tickets visible at the window [15]
- The recording quality matches a previous Mississippi show, likely taped by the same person [5]
- The performance is considered one of the tightest displays of symbiotic jamming [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-12-16.wagner.wiley.9482.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Robert Wagner; source: Audience Recording: Nak 300's [1]. Also: Taped on Nak 300s, transferred to Sony TC-158, then MC, DAT, and CDR [1]
- **gd1978-12-16.sonyecm250-dolbyb.walker-scotton.miller.82211.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) D [2]. Also: Taped on Nakamichi 300, with fades and gaps between almost every song fixed [2]
- **gd1978-12-16.sonyecm250-no-dolby.walker-scotton.miller.82212.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) D [3]
- **gd1978-12-16.aud.stephens.8841.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD, unknown mics: CM > 1C > DAT [4]. Also: A tape flip during Drums caused an indeterminable amount of missing audio [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1978-12-16 Nashville Municipal Auditorium, Nashville, TN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-12-16-nashville-municipal-auditorium-nashville-tn-usa/) [18]
